title: double view of IE's and KH's in addition with to long numbers if come from Nightscout/AAPS
symptom: When maintaining therapeutic data (injections and carbohydrates) in Nightscout/AAPS, these are shown doubled in xDrip, and sometimes the view switches to very long numbers after the comma.
cause: xDrip gets the treatments directly from AAPS, and if the download from Nightscout is activated, then it will be shown as a double entry.
fix: Deactivate the Nightscout download setting in xDrip so that xDrip will only upload data to Nightscout, not vice versa.
evidence_quote: Local fix for me: deactivate that setting, so xdrip will in future only upload the data to nightscout, and not vice versa.
